parts.label: Cell membrane
parts.info: Phospholipid bilayer that controls what enters and leaves the cell.

parts.label: Nucleus (nuclear envelope)
parts.info: Double membrane with pores enclosing the DNA.

parts.label: Nucleolus
parts.info: Makes ribosomal RNA and assembles ribosome subunits.

parts.label: Rough endoplasmic reticulum
parts.info: Membrane sheets studded with ribosomes; makes and folds secreted and membrane proteins.

parts.label: Smooth endoplasmic reticulum
parts.info: Tubules that make lipids and detoxify drugs.

parts.label: Ribosomes
parts.info: Translate mRNA into protein, free in the cytoplasm or on the rough ER.

parts.label: Mitochondria
parts.info: Site of aerobic respiration, making most of the cell's ATP.

parts.label: Cristae
parts.info: Folds of the inner mitochondrial membrane that hold the electron transport chain.

parts.label: Golgi apparatus
parts.info: Stacked cisternae that modify, sort and package proteins.

parts.label: Secretory vesicles
parts.info: Carry packaged proteins to the membrane for exocytosis.

parts.label: Lysosomes
parts.info: Contain hydrolytic enzymes that digest waste and worn-out organelles.

parts.label: Centrioles
parts.info: Pair of microtubule cylinders that organise the spindle in animal cells.
